summary: Translational Development Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting shareholder approval to extend its SPAC combination deadline. The company amended its Trust Agreement to allow up to twelve one-month extensions from June 24, 2026 to June 24, 2027, requiring a deposit of the lesser of $200,000 or $0.03 per outstanding public share per extension into the trust account. The amendment was approved at the extraordinary general meeting held June 17, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The structure involves sequential $200,000 deposits tied to public share count. Watch for whether the SPAC identifies a target or continues extending; risk-arb focuses on redemption pressure and trust value per share.
